newsitem.title: japan: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 4.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Wednesday, by Kyodo news agency.
-- Government financial reform structural conference releases budget-reduction programme, calling for a 200 billion yen cut in fiscal 1998/99 general expenditures.
-- Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp to step up early retirement programme.
-- National Police Agency, in policy shift, vows to arrest minors involved in serious crimes.
-- Major life insurance companies to boost dividends for the first time in seven years.
-- Finance Ministry report recommends limiting protection of insurance policyholders to individuals when life and non-life insurers go bankrupt.
